title: Canonical Execution Contract v1
purpose: Unify execution-aware orchestration signals, lane-worker admission control, liveness reporting, load limits, and cross-lane feedback into one contract.
verdict_basis: Execution-aware orchestration is PARTIAL: execution truth exists, but scheduling/load control is not yet unified.
non_goals: No direct cross-lane runtime code edits by this artifact

hard_rules.name: Processed requires execution truth
hard_rules.rule: No actionable message may enter processed/ unless completion-proof.js accepts proof and execution-gate.js resolves the referenced artifact or reference on disk.

hard_rules.name: Transport is not execution
hard_rules.rule: Relay delivery, inbox presence, signature validity, or schema validity must not be treated as task completion.

hard_rules.name: Actionable pending artifacts are not blocked pre-execution
hard_rules.rule: A new requires_action=true task with an expected artifact path routes to action-required/ or in-progress/, not blocked/, until the lane has had a chance to execute it.

hard_rules.name: Single governor per lane
hard_rules.rule: A lane may have one governing worker lock holder. Observer sessions must not acquire the governing lock or overwrite primary heartbeat.

hard_rules.name: Heartbeat truth over stability
hard_rules.rule: Stale, missing, malformed, or contradictory heartbeat/state signals must degrade status instead of reporting consistency.

hard_rules.name: Compaction is recovery, not scheduling
hard_rules.rule: Post-compact audit is a fallback safety boundary. It must not be the primary mechanism for load control or agent fan-out control.

hard_rules.name: Execution graph must be explicit
hard_rules.rule: Structural graph visibility must be separated from actual runtime usage. RuntimeProbe/usage reports may mark active, dormant, dead, or unproven components.

soft_rules.name: Standard runtime health panel
soft_rules.rule: All lanes should emit one compact health snapshot consumable by stable-health-panel.ps1 or equivalent.

soft_rules.name: One shared execution summary schema
soft_rules.rule: All lane-workers should report the same execution counters even when implementation remains lane-specific.

soft_rules.name: Schedule from execution signals
soft_rules.rule: Future dispatch should prioritize lanes/tasks by live queue depth, stale heartbeat status, blocked/quarantine count, and recent verified completions.

each_lane_must_return: ACK whether this contract matches current lane behavior
List gaps between current implementation and required_runtime_signals
List any clause that conflicts with lane role or existing governance
Provide evidence artifact path for the review result

confidence_basis: Read-only scan found execution gates, runtime probes, concurrency locks, recovery artifacts, and relay/task executor modules, but not one unified execution-weighted scheduler.
